definition: a device worn over the eyes that shows a virtual world
description: A watercolour-style illustration of a living room, on white with yellow squares behind. A man with dark hair and a moustache stands with his mouth wide open in joy and wears black goggles that cover his eyes. He holds a controller in each hand, with cables running to his belt, and moves his arms up and down as he plays. Behind him a television with a blue screen stands on a brown cabinet, next to a blue vase and a plant. The black device over his eyes is a headset: it shows him a virtual world that nobody else in the room can see.

de.question: Was bedeckt die Augen des Mannes?

es.answer: Un visor de realidad virtual le cubre los ojos.
es.question: ¿Qué le cubre los ojos al hombre?

fr.answer: Un casque de réalité virtuelle lui couvre les yeux.
fr.question: Qu'est-ce qui couvre les yeux de l'homme ?
